description: Files of the MeshCentral fork package that are not byte-equal to the pinned npm meshcentral@1.2.5 (test/lib/meshcentral_upstream_reference.json), checked by test/meshcentral_upstream_base_contract.js. enforced: the CRLF-normalised diff against the reference must equal upstream-base/<path>.diff exactly. pending-rebase: the file starts from forkBase, not 1.2.5, and still lacks upstream changes; it is reported until flipStage rebases it. generated: a derived copy whose content generated-assets.json governs. fork-only: not in the upstream package. removed: upstream package files the fork does not ship. A byte-equal file needs no entry.

meshagent.js.reviewed: Stage 3b (MeshCentral 5ff479199): npm 1.2.5 plus the fork hunks, from a three-way merge (base 587973e8c). Restores #8052, #8002, #8016, #8064 (getScript removed), #8015 (mc1migration removed), #7799, #7854, #7690, #7934, #7735, #7887, #7986, #7554 and the 1.2.5 compressed-core lines. Fork hunks: native update state machine (request/transfer-pending flags, agentupdatefailure/agentupdatefailed, agentupdatefailurecapability, core restore after a failed update, Windows-only native route, explicit agentupdate via command 12), native transfer fixes (task limiter completed on fs.open error, first block sliced, fd picks the disk path, EOF ends the transfer), 0x300 streaming-zip gate, all-zero hash rejected before test mode, Windows service lifecycle gate (& 0x600, with the #8052 agentInfo guard; fails closed without agentInfo), certificate history admission (isHistoricalWebCertHash, agentcertificatehistory refresh on mismatch, [AGENT_CERT_COMPAT] audit after the signature), nativeRuntimeResult no-op case. If S2 lands (ba9cbe327) the gate is & 0x400 and the diff is with-s2/meshagent.js.diff.

meshcentral.js.reviewed: Production's loader (sha256 68c45084, formerly patched at deploy time by deploy.py) plus S1.6. Three changes: core modules are added with a release version read from agents/module-versions.json, which pack.js writes from the last commit that changed packaged content (a missing manifest or module entry stops the server, naming the module; S1.6 1b34cff43 replaced the file-mtime version); only the preferred .js or .min.js copy of a module is sent; the proxy certificate is fetched with the certurl's own HTTPS hostname as SNI (align_proxy_certificate_sni).

meshdesktopmultiplex.js.reviewed: Stage 3b (MeshCentral c39d9e9be): npm 1.2.5 plus the fork hunks, from a three-way merge (base 587973e8c). Restores #8006 (rcookie guard, upstream's lines), #7671 terminalUserVariable and the consentAutoAcceptIfFileNoUser spelling. Fork hunks: held mouse button release, audio availability replay, flow control (updateAgentFlowControl, send queue used, sendQueue.length), ordered recording queue with partial writes, viewer backlog limit, image settings and pause recomputed when a viewer leaves, refresh forwarded to the agent, same-size screen re-anchor, closeWhenDrained, unresponsive agent replacement and session watchdog, outTraffc accounting, display-location reply to the viewer, peer.user null guards, image-size and off-screen tile guards, desktoprelays ownership, expireTimer cleared, pending marker not treated as a multiplexor, recording-open races, missing image guard.
